text: …I guess this means you’ve got me.

text: But he didn’t even think to look that person in the face. It didn’t matter anymore.

text: After giving the girl another pat on the head, Subaru held out his hand to her, and with a little hesitation, she grabbed it.

text: With that kind of response...

text: By the way, I thought that your hair and clothes, and also your name are pretty unusual, but… Where are you from? Why did you come to the capital of Lugunica?

text: That’s a nice attitude you have there. I can’t say I dislike it. …So, how much did that boy over there pay for it?

text: Given his current situation, and pitiful starting equipment, he couldn’t help it.

text: He felt as if he was having a not-so-well-thought-out dream, but even after pinching his cheeks and smacking his head against a wall, he wouldn’t wake up.
speaker: NARRATOR

text: Subaru didn’t want to experience that kind of death again, and that was not all.
speaker: NARRATOR

text: As Felt’s legs started to shake as she ran, she shook her head to try to deny the mess of thoughts running through it.

text: I don’t know! My body moved on its own.

text: As soon as Subaru realized that, he felt his innards twisting in pain. The feeling of guilt was even stronger than the feeling of pain he had felt when he himself was attacked.
speaker: NARRATOR

text: You really look like you’re used to this… Subaru, is your profession taming children?
speaker: SATELLA

text: As Rom looked on amazed at this mysterious item he had never seen before, Subaru quickly moved his fingers and a moment later a white light flashed in the darkness inside the building.

text: Subaru looked back in shock at the woman who smiled looking a bit unsure of how to react.

text: First of all I would like to thank my supervisor, Mister Ikemoto, for inviting me to bring this story from the World Wide Web to print, with a “Why don’t we give this a shot and show everyone what you’re made of.”

text: He coughed and vomited the blood he felt rising in his throat—the source of his waning life. So much came out that it frothed at the edges of his mouth. With his hazy vision, he could see the ground in front of him stained red.
speaker: NARRATOR

text: Subaru felt a sudden impact from his side. The impact was enough to force him to the side, and unable to catch himself, he tumbled to the ground. From Subaru’s perspective there was first pain and shock, his vision spinning as he hit the ground.
speaker: NARRATOR

text: There’s no reason for you to act like such a baby. You should be embarrassed. Aren’t you a man? …It’s true that twenty blessed gold coins is an outrageous amount. However, I remember saying that in the worst case, your metia should sell for twenty gold coins. In other words, it’s worth more than that.
speaker: ROM

text: It seems a little late to be asking this question, but that badge you say was stolen from you…does it happen to look expensive? Even if we walk in expecting to be overcharged, it would be impossible to negotiate without having any idea of what it’s worth.
speaker: NATSUKI SUBARU

text: Without having to look too long Subaru could see people with dog ears and cat ears, and there were even some who looked like they were lizardmen. But of course there were also ordinary humans, the same as Subaru.
speaker: NARRATOR

text: How did I figure it out? Oh, come on, I’m not that stupid. I mean, I’m not incredibly familiar with this area, but I’m confident in my sense of direction. The way we’ve been zig-zagging around like this, even I’m going to start to get suspicious.
speaker: Subaru

text: Looking back, Subaru had already died three times in this world. The first time was when he and Satella had visited the loot cellar together. The second time was when he, Rom, and Felt had all been cut down by Elsa’s blade. Then the third time, which to Subaru just felt like it happened a few minutes ago, he’d died a dog’s death.
speaker: NARRATOR

text: Like Subaru, the woman also had black hair, which seemed to be very rare in this world. Her hair was tied in a braid that reached all the way to her hips, the tip of which she was twirling around in her fingers.
speaker: NARRATOR

text: So this is a world with half-humans…and probably wars and adventures, too. As for whether there are any animals I’m used to around… I’m not too sure, but given that lizard cart thing…it looks like they use animals in the same way we do.
speaker: Subaru

text: I don’t really want to say this, but I think I can understand them. For the majority of people, the risk of interfering when thugs like those are involved is too great. You were right to call for guards.
speaker: Reinhard

text: Well damn, I just don’t get you. I don’t get you but…I feel like I’ve got to pay you back for not getting angry at me just now. Fine, I’ll take you straight there. I’ll just leave the rest of my doubts in Rom’s hands.
speaker: FELT

text: Subaru had imagined there would be more light and energy being bounced around. In reality, all that happened was an unrefined-looking clump of ice suddenly materialized, was used as a blunt object for physical damage, and then suddenly disappeared.

text: In Subaru’s range of vision, with his eyes open wide, he could see a tall figure with skin like a reptile…a beast-like humanoid that was only as tall as his waist…a young dancer with pink hair…a swordsman with six swords at his waist…
speaker: NARRATOR

text: With all of Subaru’s training in kendo, his sense of shame about suddenly yelling out was long gone. Additionally, Subaru, who realized at this point in his life what a loser he was, wasn’t one to let his pride be hurt by suddenly calling for help.
speaker: NARRATOR

text: As for why Subaru was so quick to accept and understand his current situation, the fact that he was a modern Japanese youth poisoned by anime and games had something to do with it, and for that he was very thankful.
speaker: NARRATOR

text: Going by everything that’s happened so far, you’d think that this would signal the start of an argument, right? I imagined you’d say something like, ‘Do you really expect me to just let a good-for-nothing like you, whose only ability is to convert oxygen into carbon dioxide, handle something this important? Don’t make me laugh! I’d expect a dog to do a better job than you!’ Then I, while hurt, would use the opportunity to renew my determination!
speaker: NATSUKI SUBARU

text: Given his occupation, Reinhard knew that this was not something he should overlook, but what other way of life did she have? What right did he have to talk of justice without offering her any alternatives?
speaker: NARRATOR

text: The second time is simple. I was already with Rom and Felt when negotiations broke down… To be killed twice by the same person… Is Elsa the kind of character that when you run into them it means certain death?
speaker: Subaru

text: It was a strategy I formed after my experiences from the first and second times in the slums, but…I never imagined it would work this well. It was a strategy I formed after my experiences from the first and second times in the slums, but…I never imagined it would work this well.
speaker: Subaru

text: Subaru shook the sleeve of his tracksuit, which was caked in dried mud. In order to help him track down Felt, the brilliant plan he’d thought of after arriving at the slums was to make himself look as down and out and destitute as possible. The first time around, when Subaru visited the slums with Not-Satella, he had not long before been beaten up by Dumb, Dumber, and Dumbest. Because of that, most of the slum’s inhabitants pitied him and were fairly cooperative. The second time, however, when Subaru hadn’t taken much damage, the people gave him a comparatively cold reception. The difference was like night and day.
speaker: NARRATOR

text: She was very tall for a woman, about the same height as Subaru, and she looked as though she were in her early twenties. The beautiful woman had eyes that angled down toward their edges and she had a certain calmness about her. One thing that stood out about her in the darkness of the loot cellar was the almost sickly whiteness of her skin. She was wearing a black coat, but the front was open and you could see that her clothes underneath were also black and were tightly fit against her skin. While she was fairly thin, she definitely had curves where they should be, and a very nice body overall.
